limitations: API_READY is an early consumable contract and controlled fixture proof, not Harness v2 or C0 production completion. T04-T18, G04-G24 and the six brand-by-facet L3 cells remain subject to their own gates.

The default product's ACP admission port reports ready=False: Q5 authorizer, one-use execution permit, native runtime generation and production pre-effect path are not wired. Missing authority refuses; controlled fixture acceptance is not production G18/G19.

Native ACP session identity is observed on the live channel, but instance generation and an operation-bound native receipt remain absent; restart reconcile must remain Unknown, not infer success from readback.

Attachment prepare/verify/release is an optional connector port with a real-byte controlled fixture. The production host has no content owner/picker port, the Server DTO does not carry preparedId or prove bytes, and the Go bridge ignores non-image resource links. Real attachment content delivery and cleanup remain open.

The native command catalog is observed only from the owner ACP channel; Chat UI has not consumed it. Legacy Ordessa continuation lacks a stable caller submission ID, so retry after a lost accepted response can duplicate. A typed Chat-to-owner-to-Server identity/outcome path remains required.
C4 same-instance replay is controlled. Cross-instance permit/effect atomicity and failure after permit consumption before journal write remain open; no Q5 production verifier is installed.

The existing .venv has an older installed harness API; source-path test commands explicitly set PYTHONPATH. The isolated wheel proof used a fresh /tmp venv. No real model, user-data migration, service restart, main merge or push occurred.
